title: Manyhands JSON v1 setup mutation
description: The data of a pull-request repo enable or remote select: the setup it recorded, with its state. A first call that published carries state published; every stop after the setup was recorded carries it too, state recorded until the remote holds the setup's branch. It holds no remote location, credential or identity.

type.description: Always setup: the tag that tells this data from every other command's.

request_id.description: The request that recorded the setup, and the one that continues it.
